ns2:course.label: Human Resource Management
ns2:course.description: Studies concepts and methods used by the staff personnel unit in building and maintaining an effective work force in an industrial organization; development of ability to design the personnel subsystem within the firm and to deal effectively with problems encountered in such areas as recruitment, selection, training, and wage and salary administration; and considerable emphasis on case analysis, role playing, and research. Credit is not given for both BADM 313 and PSYC 245. Prerequisite: BADM 310.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both BADM 313 and PSYC 245. Prerequisite: BADM 310.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Food Science & Human Nutrition or Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Business or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
